page.notes: Left margin notes are small and partly doubtful: "Forst. tollat." may read "Forst. tollat." with an unclear abbreviation; "Corvin." and "omnt. Meli." (probably Corvin. Mell.) and "ua.c.4.f.4." are uncertain, and "†. 51." is a dagger or flat sign and may be misread. Their exact placement beside lines is approximate. A stray mark appears in the left margin beside the line "Vorstius (vere tamen"; it is not text and is left out. Long s is transcribed as s throughout, so "f" forms such as "mollirefatagens" are read as "mollire-satagens" (f = long s). "Vorstij" and "Vorstii" are read as printed. Pagination and running head are as printed.
